paragraphs.en: Agent Substrate Zero-trust sandboxing for millions of agents on Kubernetes.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体基座（Agent Substrate） 在 Kubernetes 上为数百万智能体提供零信任沙箱环境。

paragraphs.en: Quickstart · Security · Architecture · Contributing
paragraphs.zh: 快速入门 · 安全 · 架构 · 贡献指南

paragraphs.en: Agent Substrate is a security-hardened, zero-trust runtime for sandboxed agents, engineered to safely run millions of agents and tools with 10x higher density than standard containers. Purpose-built for the era of autonomous agents, Substrate delivers fast resume operations in less than 400ms, with more than 1500 activations per second. Agents get isolated compute, identity, networking, and storage. Sensitive credentials are kept out of reach from untrusted code. It supports multiple sandbox technologies, including microVMs and gVisor, while enabling a consistent lifecycle and management of all sandboxes.
paragraphs.zh: Agent Substrate 是一个经过安全加固、面向零信任的沙箱智能体运行时，旨在安全运行数百万个智能体和工具，密度达到标准容器的 10 倍。 Substrate 为自主智能体时代量身打造，可在 400 毫秒内完成快速恢复操作，每秒支持超过 1500 次激活。 智能体拥有隔离的计算、身份、网络和存储。 敏感凭据不会被不可信代码触及。 它支持多种沙箱技术，包括 microVM 和 gVisor，同时为所有沙箱提供一致的生命周期与管理。

paragraphs.en: At its core, Agent Substrate maps a larger set of “actors” (stateful workloads such as agents) onto a smaller pool of ready “workers”. Because agents spend most of their lives waiting on models, tools, or humans, Substrate snapshots idle actors out of memory and restores them when a request arrives.
paragraphs.zh: Agent Substrate 的核心在于，将更大的一组“行动者”（有状态的工作负载，例如智能体）映射到规模较小的就绪“工作者”池上。 由于智能体的大部分时间都花在等待模型、工具或人类上，Substrate 会将空闲的行动者从内存中快照出去，并在请求到达时将其恢复。

paragraphs.en: Substrate is a low-opinion runtime, not an agent SDK. The workloads it runs do not have to be AI agents, though autonomous, untrusted, mostly-idle agents are the target for its isolation and scheduling model. It runs on standard Kubernetes: Pods, autoscaling, NetworkPolicies. It adds agent-specific scheduling, snapshotting, identity, and network mediation. This allows agentic, inference, training, and reinforcement learning workloads to share one infrastructure plane.
paragraphs.zh: Substrate 是一个低主观预设的运行时，而不是一个智能体 SDK。 它运行的负载不必是 AI 智能体，不过自主、不可信、大部分时间处于空闲状态的智能体正是其隔离与调度模型的目标场景。 它运行在标准 Kubernetes 之上：Pod、自动扩缩容、NetworkPolicies。 它增加了针对智能体的调度、快照、身份与网络中介功能。 这使得智能体、推理、训练和强化学习负载能够共享同一个基础设施平面。

paragraphs.en: Substrate treats every actor as untrusted and mutually hostile, so tenants can share physical nodes without sharing a security boundary. Every control operates within the cold-start and resume budget. See the Security Guide for the full list of security principles and threat model.
paragraphs.zh: Substrate 将每个参与者都视为不可信且相互敌对的，因此租户可以共享物理节点而不共享安全边界。 每个控制机制都在冷启动和恢复的预算范围内运行。 完整的安全原则与威胁模型列表请参阅《安全指南》。

paragraphs.en: Framework Agnostic & Compatibility Agent Substrate is framework and agent harness agnostic . Because it runs standard OCI container images inside gVisor or microVM sandboxes and enforces security outside the workload, it hosts agents built on any stack without SDK changes:
paragraphs.zh: 框架无关与兼容性：Agent Substrate 对框架和智能体运行环境（agent harness）保持无关。 由于它在 gVisor 或 microVM 沙箱中运行标准 OCI 容器镜像，并在工作负载之外实施安全控制，因此无需修改 SDK 即可托管基于任何技术栈构建的智能体：

paragraphs.en: To quickly set up the complete environment:
paragraphs.zh: 为了快速搭建完整环境：

paragraphs.en: Make sure you have Go , kubectl , and docker installed and configured on your dev machine. We will automatically manage other dependencies via Go, including kind . A Linux host that will run more than about a thousand sandboxes also needs a larger kernel neighbor table ( net.ipv4.neigh.default.gc_thresh1/2/3 = 4096/16384/32768); hack/create-kind-cluster.sh warns when the host is at the default of 1024.
paragraphs.zh: 请确保你的开发机上已安装并配置好 Go、kubectl 和 docker。 我们将通过 Go 自动管理其他依赖项，包括 kind。 将运行超过约一千个沙箱的 Linux 主机还需要更大的内核邻居表（net.ipv4.neigh.default.gc_thresh1/2/3 = 4096/16384/32768）；当主机使用默认值 1024 时，hack/create-kind-cluster.sh 会发出警告。

paragraphs.en: # create cluster and local registry (IPv4; IP_FAMILY=dual|ipv6 overrides) hack/create-kind-cluster.sh # install ate, PostgreSQL, rustfs hack/install-ate-kind.sh deploy ate-system --credential-provider= ' {"name":"k8s.io"} ' # install counter demo hack/install-ate-kind.sh deploy demo-counter # install kubectl-ate go install ./cmd/kubectl-ate # create a counter actor in the demo's atespace (--template names the # actor template, resolved in the actor's atespace) kubectl ate create actor my-counter-1 -a ate-demo-counter --template counter # port-forward the network router to bind to local port `8000` kubectl port-forward -n ate-system svc/atenet-router 8000:80 Important
paragraphs.zh: # 创建集群和本地镜像仓库（IPv4；IP_FAMILY=dual|ipv6 可覆盖）hack/create-kind-cluster.sh # 安装 ate、PostgreSQL、rustfs hack/install-ate-kind.sh deploy ate-system --credential-provider= ' {"name":"k8s.io"} ' # 安装 counter 演示 hack/install-ate-kind.sh deploy demo-counter # 安装 kubectl-ate go install ./cmd/kubectl-ate # 在演示的 atespace 中创建一个 counter 智能体（--template 指定 # 智能体模板，在该智能体的 atespace 中解析） kubectl ate create actor my-counter-1 -a ate-demo-counter --template counter # 将网络路由器端口转发并绑定到本地端口 `8000` kubectl port-forward -n ate-system svc/atenet-router 8000:80 重要提示

paragraphs.en: {"name":"k8s.io"} deploys the bundled credential provider with an empty, default-deny namespace policy. Before an actor can have a credential injected, grant its atespace the namespaces whose Secrets it may read; see Enable it .
paragraphs.zh: {"name":"k8s.io"} 会部署内置的凭证提供程序，并附带一个默认拒绝的空命名空间策略。 在某个参与者（actor）能获得凭证注入之前，请授予其 atespace 相应命名空间，以便其可以读取这些命名空间中的 Secret；参见“启用它”。

paragraphs.en: Deploy the Agent Substrate system to your cluster:
paragraphs.zh: 将 Agent Substrate 系统部署到你的集群：

paragraphs.en: go run ./cmd/ate-setup deploy ate-system --credential-provider= ' {"name":"k8s.io"} ' --credential-provider is required. {"name":"k8s.io"} also deploys the bundled Kubernetes Secrets provider, with a NetworkPolicy that admits only the egress gateway; {"enabled":false} turns egress credential injection off (see docs/egress-credential-injection.md ). ATE_CREDENTIAL_PROVIDER in .ate-dev-env.sh is the same choice.

paragraphs.en: Credential injection needs a namespace policy. The bundled provider starts with an empty, default-deny one, so it resolves no Secrets until you grant each atespace the namespaces it may read; see Enable it .

paragraphs.en: go run ./tools/setup-gcp create cluster go run ./tools/setup-gcp create bucket To run the PostgreSQL store backend on Cloud SQL — with IAM database authentication and no passwords — see tools/setup-gcp/cloud-sql.md .
paragraphs.zh:
go run ./tools/setup-gcp create cluster
go run ./tools/setup-gcp create bucket

要在 Cloud SQL 上运行 PostgreSQL 存储后端（使用 IAM 数据库认证，无需密码），请参阅 tools/setup-gcp/cloud-sql.md。

paragraphs.en: Similarly, you can deploy or cleanup specific Agent Substrate components using the installation script. See go run ./cmd/ate-setup for all options.
paragraphs.zh: 同样地，你可以使用安装脚本来部署或清理特定的智能体基础设施组件。 所有选项请参见 go run ./cmd/ate-setup。

sents.en: Similarly, you can deploy or cleanup specific Agent Substrate components using the installation script.
sents.zh: 同样地，你可以使用安装脚本来部署或清理特定的智能体基础设施组件。

sents.en: See go run ./cmd/ate-setup for all options.
sents.zh: 所有选项请参见 go run ./cmd/ate-setup。

paragraphs.en: # Re-deploy only ate-apiserver of the ATE system go run ./cmd/ate-setup deploy apiserver # Delete everything (core system and all demos) go run ./cmd/ate-setup delete all Tearing down resources (GCP) If you need to delete the resources created by the setup script, you can use the provided script hack/teardown.sh . This script will delete resources in the reverse order of creation and handles partial failures gracefully.
paragraphs.zh: # 仅重新部署 ATE 系统的 ate-apiserver go run ./cmd/ate-setup deploy apiserver # 删除所有内容（核心系统和所有演示） go run ./cmd/ate-setup delete all 拆除资源（GCP）如果需要删除由设置脚本创建的资源，可以使用提供的脚本 hack/teardown.sh 。 该脚本会按创建时的相反顺序删除资源，并能妥善处理部分失败的情况。

sents.zh: # 仅重新部署 ATE 系统的 ate-apiserver go run ./cmd/ate-setup deploy apiserver # 删除所有内容（核心系统和所有演示） go run ./cmd/ate-setup delete all 拆除资源（GCP）如果需要删除由设置脚本创建的资源，可以使用提供的脚本 hack/teardown.sh 。

sents.en: This script will delete resources in the reverse order of creation and handles partial failures gracefully.
sents.zh: 该脚本会按创建时的相反顺序删除资源，并能妥善处理部分失败的情况。

paragraphs.en: ./hack/teardown.sh --all Or run individual teardown steps as needed (see ./hack/teardown.sh for available options).
paragraphs.zh: ./hack/teardown.sh --all 或者根据需要运行单个拆卸步骤（可用选项请参见 ./hack/teardown.sh）。
